title: tzdata variables
description: Configuration variables for IANA Time Zone Database (tzdata)

TZDATA_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install tzdata. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

TZDATA_VERSION.description: Specific version of tzdata to install.

TZDATA_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading tzdata binary or archive artifacts.

TZDATA_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying tzdata available remote releases.

TZDATA_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., UTC or America/New_York) staged into /etc/timezone and /etc/localtime.
